sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: What did the usability test show?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Four out of five people couldn't find the settings page.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Wow.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It was painful to watch.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: In the usability test, four of five people never found the settings page.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That bad?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Honestly, yes.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Quick thing about the roadmap.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The integrations team now says they can't start our connector until next quarter.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Hmm, that pushes everything.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: What's the roadmap issue?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The integrations team can't pick up our connector before next quarter.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That pushes a lot of things back.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yeah.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Have you looked at the churn survey?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Just this morning.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The top reason for leaving is missing integrations, ahead of price.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Interesting, I'd have guessed price.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Churned customers mostly cite missing integrations, even more than price.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Really?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I was surprised too.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I got the analytics numbers for the new feature.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: About {PERCENT} of active users tried it in the first week.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, {PERCENT}, noted.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Is that good?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: It's above what we expected.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Any numbers on the new feature?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: In week one, {PERCENT} of active users tried it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Did you say {PERCENT}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Which beats our expectation.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Nice.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Did legal reply about the data retention question?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Yes, we have to delete inactive accounts after two years.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, that's clearer than I thought.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Legal got back to us on retention.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Inactive accounts must be deleted after two years.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Good, at least it's clear.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I spoke to {CLIENT} about the beta.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: They want the bulk edit feature before they'll roll it out to the whole company.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Makes sense for a big account.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: How did the {CLIENT} conversation go?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: They won't roll out company-wide without bulk edit.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That's fair for their size.
